description: Client-side JavaScript for shopping cart functionality in ERPNext, including cart updates, dropdown handling, cookie management, and UI updates.

methods.name: getParams
methods.description: Parses URL query parameters into an object.

methods.name: show_shoppingcart_dropdown
methods.description: Displays shopping cart dropdown menu, loads content via AJAX if not already loaded.

methods.name: update_cart
methods.description: Updates shopping cart items; redirects to login if user is guest.

methods.name: set_cart_count
methods.description: Updates cart icon and message based on cart item count.

methods.name: shopping_cart_update
methods.description: Updates cart item quantity and UI, with loading and error handling.

methods.name: bind_dropdown_cart_buttons
methods.description: Binds click events to increment/decrement buttons in cart dropdown.

methods.name: show_cart_navbar
methods.description: Checks if cart is enabled and toggles cart visibility in navbar.
